title: PDF, ODT, Markdown and HTML publishers
summary: DOCY owns semantic nodes and delegates output to existing ooRexx providers.
semantics: DOCY's PDF/ODT node methods use injected PdfFlowReport/PdfTable and OdtAccess/OdtTable provider APIs.
DOCY's native archive adapter reuses oorexx_archive and emits ODT mimetype first as a stored ZIP entry.
Provider errors produce STOP diagnostics rather than false successful publication paths.
SVG embedding, full office fidelity and actual PDF/ODT binary conformance have not been qualified.
Exported office documents remain projections of the authoritative graph.
